name: Faraday Technology Corporation
summary: Faraday Technology Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a fabless ASIC/SoC and silicon intellectual property (IP) provider in China, Taiwan, Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company offers ASIC/SoC design services, including architecture exploration, integration express, verification exploration, SoReal! 2.0 virtual platform, and CPU development services; SoC platforms, such as OSKit, FlashKit, HiSpeedKit, and FPGAKit; turnkey solutions comprising process technology, design methodology, fabrication services, package services, test services, failure analysis, and reliability services; and SONOS eFlash platform, UMC 14nm, 28/22nm ASIC solution, FPGA-Go-ASI…
